verdict.rationale: Calendly publishes a developer API reference for its REST-based API v2 (an api-docs section exists, e.g. webhook signatures) and guides with code snippets such as `Calendly.initInlineWidget`. Nothing in the evidence shows the reference is interactive or that examples can be run in the browser. Missing for 10: an interactive try-it console or explorer, runnable examples against live or sandbox endpoints, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
